title: Reference approach: Signal Analysis Workbench
approach: Define the scientific question, inputs, units, output, and domain assumptions.
Separate loading, validation, calculation, and reporting into reusable functions.
Compare the selected SciPy method against a known result, residual, or independent approach.
Test normal, boundary, invalid, and non-finite inputs as applicable.
Record package versions, parameters, uncertainty, and known limitations.
acceptance_guidance: Inspect the frequency spectrum and power spectral density.
Select a filter and document the cutoff/design choices.
Detect peaks and compare raw and processed output.
explanation: Reference design for Signal Analysis Workbench. This file provides solution guidance rather than claiming a complete reviewed production implementation. All project data should be synthetic or properly licensed.
